fields.options:
Controls which Job Applicant fields may carry an Applicable To rule in Job Applicant Profile Settings.

A field is filterable by default. Listing it below removes its Applicable To switch, so its visibility can never be narrowed to a subset of companies or assignments — use this for fields every application must always collect (name, email, mobile).

Removing a field from this list restores the switch. A field already carrying a rule when it is added here keeps the stored rule but stops enforcing it, so the rule returns intact if the exclusion is lifted.
